description: Client-side script for generating and updating a Gantt chart in the SuiteCRM Project module, including AJAX calls for chart updates and tooltips, and UI interactions for navigation between months.

methods.name: gen_chart
methods.description: Generates the Gantt chart by calling the server via AJAX with selected parameters and updates the DOM.

methods.name: add_tooltips
methods.description: Adds tooltips to chart elements by fetching tooltip content via AJAX and initializing qTip plugin.
